beats.settlement_evolution_usage: settlement.evolution payload: artifact|summary[|c=<kept>/<screened>[|cls=<kind>:<n>,...]][|sessions=<moved>/<remaining>/<destination>][|todo=<remaining>/<verified_by>]; summary is required after trim and must not contain |; the only optional segments are c=, cls=, sessions= and todo= — ev=, duplicates and unknown segments are refused.
beats.settlement_evolution_ok: [EVOLUTION REGISTERED] {{summary}} | candidates {{candidates}} (kept/screened) | classes {{classes}}. Sessions and todo are settled in the same transaction when their segments are present; review.note archives single-source and closes the run.
beats.settlement_evolution_missing: evolution registration is missing: run settlement.evolution first; summary must be non-empty after trim (artifact may stay empty when c=0/0).
beats.settlement_evolution_verify_first: run verify.submit all_green=true before settlement.evolution / review.note.
beats.settlement_evolution_default_summary: candidates screened against the evolution chapter
beats.review_common: once every gate is green, register settlement.evolution first (it settles sessions and todo in the same transaction), then review.note records the lesson and archives single-source to close the run; screen candidates against the evolution chapter first. summary is required after trim; when screened > 0 artifact and cls are required, c=0/0 allows an empty artifact; a declaration only proves what was declared, not the quality of the suggestions.
beats.review_note_usage: review.note accepts only lesson|score; the evolution record must be registered through settlement.evolution first — this action only archives it single-source.
beats.review_note_legacy_evolution: review.note no longer accepts ev= / c= / cls= segments; register with settlement.evolution first, then close with lesson|score.
beats.review_evolution_bad_path: invalid evolution artifact path: must be `artifacts/<file>.md`, no `..` and no whitespace.
beats.review_evolution_bad_candidates: invalid evolution candidate count: `c=<kept>/<screened>`, two non-negative integers with kept <= screened.
beats.review_evolution_bad_classes: invalid evolution candidate classes: `cls=<kind>:<n>,...`, kind must be one of the six classes, counts non-negative and unique.
beats.review_evolution_mismatch: the evolution declaration is not self-consistent: the cls counts must sum to screened, and the kept classes (long_term + unused + redundant) must sum to kept.
beats.review_evolution_need_artifact: with candidates (screened > 0) the first segment of settlement.evolution must be `artifacts/<file>.md` — every screened candidate needs a review record, not only the kept ones.
beats.review_evolution_need_classes: with candidates (screened > 0) you must provide per-class root-cause counts: cls=<kind>:<n>,... (the six classes sum to screened, the kept classes sum to kept).
beats.settlement_evolution_bad_segment: settlement.evolution does not accept the segment `{{segment}}`: the optional segments are c=, cls=, sessions= and todo=; legacy ev= and unknown segments are refused.
beats.settlement_evolution_duplicate_segment: the c= / cls= / sessions= / todo= segments must not repeat.
beats.settlement_evolution_need_summary: the settlement.evolution summary must be non-empty after trim; with zero candidates you may register the neutral summary and c=0/0 with an empty artifact.
beats.settlement_sessions_missing: subagent sessions are not settled (settlement.sessions, remaining must be 0)
beats.settlement_sessions_ok: subagent sessions settled: moved {{moved}} to {{destination}} (files renamed into the trash directory — not a permanent deletion; no per-file guarantee about which sessions were spared: verify the destination yourself).
beats.settlement_sessions_usage: settlement.sessions payload "moved|remaining|destination": moved a non-negative integer, remaining exactly 0, destination non-empty (e.g. <your-destination>/<batch>); all three segments are required.
beats.settlement_sessions_segment_bad: the settlement.evolution sessions= segment must be `<moved>/<remaining>/<destination>`: moved a non-negative integer, remaining exactly 0, destination non-empty (slashes inside the destination are kept).
beats.settlement_todo_missing: the main-session todo list is not settled (settlement.todo, remaining must be 0)
beats.settlement_todo_ok: main-session todo list cleared: re-checked to 0 items (basis: {{verified_by}}).
beats.settlement_todo_payload: 0|main session todo list re-checked to 0 items (done + historical included)
beats.settlement_todo_usage: settlement.todo payload "remaining|verified_by": exactly two segments, remaining exactly 0, verified_by non-empty and <= 120 chars.
beats.settlement_todo_segment: todo=0/main session todo list re-checked to 0 items (done + historical included)
beats.settlement_todo_segment_bad: the settlement.evolution todo= segment must be `<remaining>/<verified_by>`: remaining exactly 0, verified_by non-empty and <= 120 chars.
beats.settlement_verify_first: record all-green evidence with verify.submit first, then register the three settlement tasks (all of them in the review stage).
beats.settlement_sessions_unsetted_hint: [SESSIONS CLEANUP PENDING] subagent sessions remaining={{remaining}} — review.note stays blocked. Cleanup is prompt-driven: use your own environment's native session-management capability to delete the subagent session records produced by this run; scope strictly to this run's artifacts; the main session and unrelated sessions must never be touched; moved=0 is a legal outcome. When done, declare the result via settlement.sessions (moved/remaining/destination) or the settlement.evolution sessions= segment. A missing declaration stays honestly unsettled.
beats.review_batch_ok: [BATCH {{batch}} SETTLED] score {{score}}/5 — {{lesson}}; evolution archived to the rolling slot; batch counter -> {{next}}; back to coordinate — the resident run waits for the next batch.
beats.settlement_artifact_no_vfs: artifact {{artifact}} cannot be verified: the host VFS is not mounted — non-empty registration refused (no settlement written, no archive side effects)
beats.settlement_artifact_absent: artifact {{artifact}} does not exist in the mounted VFS — registration refused (no settlement written, no archive side effects)
beats.settlement_artifact_empty: artifact {{artifact}} is empty in the mounted VFS — registration refused (no settlement written, no archive side effects)
beats.settlement_artifact_read_error: artifact {{artifact}} probe failed — registration refused (no settlement written, no archive side effects)
